# Casa Amani

> A luxury vacation villa in Arco da Calheta, Madeira, Portugal.

Casa Amani is a 234 m² atlantic-facing villa on Madeira's sunny south-west coast. It sits on the hills of Arco da Calheta, overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. The village is 1 kilometre downhill; Funchal and the airport are forty-five minutes by car.

## The property

- 2 + 1 bedrooms (main bedroom with ocean view, guest bedroom, lower room with twin beds)
- 234 m² of living space
- Heated private swimming pool
- Open-plan living with direct terrace access
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Outdoor dining area with gas barbecue
- Family bathroom with rain shower
- Fibre WiFi and dedicated workspaces
- Garage for 2 cars

## Location

- Address: Arco da Calheta, Madeira, Portugal
- Coordinates: 32.7333°N, 17.1667°W
- Coast: South-west (sunny side of Madeira)
- Distance to Funchal: ~45 minutes by car
- Distance to airport: ~45 minutes by car
- Distance to village: ~1 km downhill
